resources.string: Follow the caret while typing or moving it, including space-bar cursor gestures. Requires the editor to expose cursor geometry. Pauses in Quiet Mode.

With Android accessibility access, ANeko can follow the caret in a focused text editor that exposes character positions. Password fields and fields Android marks sensitive are excluded. Some editors do not expose usable positions. Typed content is not saved, logged, or sent to the watch or a server. The pet stays beside the caret without typing or tapping.\n\nThis option is off by default. Accessibility access is enabled separately in Android Settings.
Fast scrolling can fling pets sitting over the moving pane, followed by a short slide. Pets outside that pane stay put. Pauses in Quiet Mode.

With Android accessibility access, ANeko uses scroll movement and the bounds of the scrolling pane to nudge only pets inside that pane. Fixed headers and other screen areas are unaffected when the app exposes separate bounds. Apps that hide scrolling bounds or movement may not react. No screen captures or scroll history are saved or uploaded.\n\nThis option is off by default. Accessibility access is enabled separately in Android Settings.
Accessibility service connected. Reactions use the cursor and scroll bounds that each app exposes.
Enable ANeko screen reactions in Android Accessibility settings to use these optional features.
Enable a typing or scrolling reaction first.
